Favorability polling is different. It focuses on how voters feel about the person in general.

Civiqs' national favorability data shows 58% of voters have a negative outlook on the president. About 38% of people viewed him favorably as of Aug. 31. Mississippi polling has the same results.

YouGov's poll for The Economist says Trump stands at 58% unfavorable, 39.6% favorable, and 2.4% don't know as of Aug. 10. [...] Trump has a 45% approval rating in Mississippi, according to Aug. 31 polling data from Civiqs. That's the lowest ever for the state.

His disapproval rating is 49%, which is also the highest for both terms. About 6% neither approve nor disapprove.

Trump started this term in 2025
results.title: Trump approval rating falls to new low in Mississippi, US polls

# Trump hits negative approval rating in Tennessee for first time

Portrait of Jordan Green

President Donald Trump's approval rating in Tennessee has officially dipped into the negatives, according to recent Civiqs polling.

According to Civiqs, an organization that surveys thousands of Americans daily about their views on politics and current events, Tennessee switched to having a negative approval rating of the president in early September, and the gap has only grown since. [...] At the beginning of September, Civiqs recorded Trump with a net approval rating of 1% in the state, and it has now flipped to a net approval rating of -4% as of Sept. 12.
